The institutional investor held 1.29M shares of the consumer non-durables company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $24.48M, down from 1.41M at the end of the previous reported quarter. Armistice Capital Llc who had been investing in Freshpet Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $758.44M market cap company. The stock decreased 0.92% or $0.2 during the last trading session, reaching $21.55. About 53,992 shares traded. Freshpet, Inc. (NASDAQ:FRPT) has risen 43.42% since May 21, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 31.87% the S&P500.
